newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Boral sells British coal ash unit.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Boral sells British coal ash unit.

text.p: Energy and building products group Boral Ltd said on Monday it had sold its British coal ash marketer Pozzolanic Lytag Ltd to the Rugby Group Plc for about four million stg or A$8 million.
Pozzolanic Lytag markets fly ash, a by-product of coal-fired power stations largely used as a cement substitute in concrete, Boral said.

"The sale of Pozzolanic Lytag follows on from the divestments earlier this year of Boral's UK masonry business and the Kindisch quarry and sand and gravel interests in east Germany," Boral Managing Director Tony Berg said in a statement.

"As previously announced, we are conducting an extensive review of Boral's remaining operations in Europe, which is concentrating on the clay brick and tile operations with the intent of developing strategies to improve the return on our
Boral shares were three cents firmer at A$3.16 at 12.30 p.m. (0230 GMT).
